'''Relaali Zone One''' was the traditional [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[244Core]].

==Characteristics==
Located in the central sector of [[Zone One]], Reelali was the traditional capital of [[244Core]], and was named after [[Relaali]], the negotiator who first brokered peace between the corporations and formed the [[Corporate Committee]] and the position of [[Chief Administrator/Legends|Chief Administrator]].<ref name="Unknown" />

A large city surrounded by industrial [[Mining/Legends|mining]] facilities, company-owned living quarters, three major ground and [[speeder]] transportation hubs, and the most sophisticated [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the planet, Reelali was home to the local offices of every major corporation on the planet. Over the centuries, [[Zone One]] and Relaali proper had been struck by [[meteorite]]s, with the impact craters being visible in the city's layout. Because of these regular impacts, the planet's administrative center was located deep under the city, and was the hub of corporate politics on the planet.<ref name="Unknown" />
